title: Approaching Backpropagation Accuracy with Weight Perturbation on MNIST
abstract: arXiv:2610.21665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight perturbation (WP) estimates learning directions from random parameter perturbations and a scalar change in loss, without backpropagating derivatives. We examine how batch size, training duration, and estimator stabilization affect its attainable accuracy in fully connected MNIST networks. In the shallow configuration, large-batch training reaches approximately 97\% test accuracy, compared with an early backpropagation (BP) reference near 97.5--98\%. The same comparison exposes a substantial efficiency gap: under a ten-epoch budget, shallow WP reaches 90.2\%, whereas the reported BP reference reaches 97.4\%. Epoch-indexed curves show diminishing returns from increasing batch size beyond 4,000. Learning-rate reduction and averaging independent perturbation-based updates also stabilize deeper networks, although their recorded results do not establish BP-level accuracy. We distinguish these empirical findings from a finite-horizon app

translated_title: 在MNIST上利用权重扰动逼近反向传播的精度
translated_abstract: 权重扰动（WP）通过随机参数扰动和损失的标量变化来估计学习方向，无需反向传播导数。我们研究了批大小、训练时长和估计器稳定化如何影响该方法在全连接MNIST网络中可达到的精度。在浅层配置中，大批量训练达到约97%的测试精度，而早期反向传播（BP）参考约为97.5–98%。同样的比较也揭示了显著的效率差距：在十个epoch的预算下，浅层WP达到90.2%，而所报告的BP参考达到97.4%。按epoch索引的曲线显示，批大小超过4,000后收益递减。降低学习率以及对独立的基于扰动的更新进行平均也能稳定更深的网络，尽管其记录的结果尚未达到BP级别的精度。我们将这些实证发现与有限时域的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究系统考察了权重扰动方法在MNIST全连接网络中的表现，发现浅层网络经大批量训练可达约97%测试精度、接近早期反向传播水平，但训练效率仍存在明显差距，且深层网络尚未达到BP级精度。
en_tdlr: This study systematically examines weight perturbation on fully-connected MNIST networks, showing that shallow networks with large-batch training can reach about 97% test accuracy—approaching early backpropagation levels—though a substantial efficiency gap remains and deeper networks do not yet achieve BP-level accuracy.
